bodyHtml:
Our HCG 2.0 program combines the traditional HCG diet with the powerful appetite suppression found in Adipex.  Nasal spray and injectable HCG programs are available.

We are running a special introductory price for our 4-stage HCG 2.0 diet with a 4-week stage 2 at $495 + $30/month for Adipex.  The HCG and Adipex both get shipped directly to your door and are highest-quality, pharmaceutical grade.

Patients must meet their state’s phentermine BMI guidelines to qualify for this program.  Click here to see our medical weight loss BMI calculator.
